_meta.description: Text input family: TextField (Box + Line types) and TextArea (Box only). TextField/Box/Hero excluded per request. All use Pretendard Medium with 1.5 line-height. States: Enabled, Hover, Focused, Typing, Filled, Error, Disabled — coverage varies per variant (see each block).

textField._description: Single-line text input. Two visual types — Box (bordered rectangle) and Line (underline-only). Box has sub-variants Box (standard) and Big (larger font for numeric/money input). Line has sub-variants Line (standard) and Big (very large display input).

box._description: Standard bordered text field. Used in forms inside modals, bottom sheets, or complex input pages.

hover._note: Not extracted in this session — Figma has a Hover variant; defaults likely close to Enabled with slightly darker border. Verify before using.

optionalSlots.label: Uses Resource/Label — Asterisk/Negative variants. In Error state, the Label switches to the Negative=True variant automatically (red text).

unit.description: Optional right-side unit text (e.g. '원'). 16px Regular, color {label.900}

trailingButton.description: Optional Line-style button (e.g. '버튼') sitting to the right of the input as a suffix action.

description.description: Helper text below input. 12px Medium. Color changes per state (default {label.600}, error {status.error}).

big._description: Large bordered text field. Used for emphasized numeric/money inputs or important single-field data entry.

unit.description: Larger unit label (e.g. '원'). 22px Medium title4, color {label.800}.

line._description: Underline-only text field. Used on narrow mobile screens where margin needs preserving, or as a supplementary input inside information-dense lists.

negativeOverride._description: When Negative=True, the following tokens switch to error colors. Applies to Typing and Filled.

time.description: Countdown timer display (e.g. '02:57'). 16px Regular body1 {label.900}, padded 4px on x with radius 6.

description._note: Non-standard tight line-height (1.125) on description — preserve.

big._description: Very large display text field. Used for separated input steps on narrow mobile screens or fields needing strong visual feedback.

box._description: Multi-line text input. Box-only (no Line variant). Used for long-form user content with optional checkbox + character counter + info badge row below.

hover._note: Not extracted in this session — similar to Enabled.

typing._note: Not extracted individually — follows Focused pattern with cursor {brand.600}.

descriptionRow._description: Optional row below the textarea holding helper text + controls. All slots optional; laid out horizontally with 6px gap.

badge.description: Small info badge on the right end (e.g. '맞춤법검사').

scrollBar._description: Optional vertical scrollbar shown when content exceeds height.

resources._description: Atomic parts reused inside the above text inputs. They can also appear standalone in forms.

label._description: Field label sitting above the input. 4 variants from 2 booleans (Asterisk, Negative).

infoIcon.role: tooltip trigger — appears to the right of the label text

time._description: Countdown timer used inside inputs (e.g. verification code expiry).

scope: Desktop size variants: there are no Desktop/Mobile platform variants for Text Input — sizes are M/S (Box/Box) and M (Box/Big). Line variants have no sizes.
Some states (Hover for Box/Box, Hover/Typing for TextArea) were not individually extracted and are flagged with _note fields. For now, treat them as following the Enabled→Focused transition pattern.
color_patterns: Focused border always flips to {label.800} (#333) / {gray.800} — neutral dark instead of brand color. The BRAND color appears only in Line variants and in cursors.
Cursors: static-position focused cursor uses {gray.700}; actively-typing cursor uses {brand.600}. Line variants use brand.600 for both (they have a single Focus state that covers cursor position).
Negative=True / Error state: border + label text + description + separator all switch to {status.error}. Input value text stays {label.900} (legible) — only surrounding chrome turns red.
Disabled: Box types use {background.alternative} bg with {label.300} border; Line types keep transparent bg and only dim text/label to {label.400} or keep {label.900}.
TextArea error state shows the same Border/Description red as TextField but text color shifts to {label.800} (slightly darker than default placeholder {label.500}) to emphasize the error value.
typography_quirks: Line variant description uses lineHeight 1.125 (tight) instead of system default 1.5.
Box/Big and Line/Big use 22px (title4) for input, 32px for Line/Big — notably larger than the 16px body1 used elsewhere.
_notes.token_references: Values like {background.default}, {label.800}, {gray.300}, {brand.600}, {status.error}, {stroke.solid}, {badge.background}, {badge.stock}, {badge.font} resolve against ~/design-system/colors/*.json. Font aliases (body1, body2, title4, heading1) resolve against ~/design-system/typography/typography.json.
